title: Class-Conditional Conformal Triage for ICAO Face-Image Compliance under Class Imbalance
abstract: arXiv:2611.25342v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated ICAO/ISO face-image compliance analysers provide criterion-level pass/fail decisions, yet these verdicts do not quantify uncertainty when deciding whether to accept, reject, or retake a photograph. We investigate conformal prediction as a triage layer for BioGaze, evaluating 14 compliance criteria on the synthetic TONO benchmark. Without retraining the analyser, we fit per-criterion logistic classifiers and compare marginal and label-conditional (Mondrian) conformal prediction with conventional abstention rules using subject-disjoint splits. Marginal conformal prediction achieved approximately 0.90 overall coverage but substantially under-covered violations, with a ten-partition mean of 0.37 for one criterion. The corresponding Mondrian means ranged from 0.89 to 0.92 across criteria. translated_title: 类别不平衡条件下面向ICAO人脸图像合规检测的类别条件化保形分流方法
translated_abstract: 自动化的ICAO/ISO人脸图像合规分析器可提供准则级别的通过/不通过判定，但在决定接受、拒绝或重拍照片时，这些判定并未量化不确定性。我们研究了将保形预测作为BioGaze的分流层，在合成TONO基准上对14项合规准则进行了评估。在不重新训练分析器的前提下，我们为每项准则拟合逻辑回归分类器，并使用受试者不重叠的数据划分，将边际保形预测与标签条件化（Mondrian）保形预测及传统弃权规则进行比较。边际保形预测实现了约0.90的整体覆盖率，但对违规情况存在明显的覆盖不足，某一准则的十分区平均覆盖率仅为0.37。而相应的Mondrian方法在各准则上的平均覆盖率范围为0.89至0.92。然而，准则级别假阳性的大部分降低来自逻辑回归层（从0.145降至0.048），而经过调优的弃权规则实现了……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该研究提出将标签条件化（Mondrian）保形预测作为ICAO人脸图像合规分析的分流层，在不重新训练模型的情况下解决了类别不平衡导致的违规判定覆盖不足问题，将各准则的违规覆盖率从边际方法的0.37提升至0.89-0.92。
en_tdlr: This study proposes label-conditional (Mondrian) conformal prediction as a triage layer for ICAO face-image compliance analysis, addressing violation under-coverage caused by class imbalance without retraining the analyzer, improving per-criterion violation coverage from 0.37 (marginal) to 0.89–0.92.
